final_determination.explanation: The CLIN officially defines 68 linguistic groupings in 5 independent canonical locations. All 68 appear in the index (pp.11-12), catalog main body (pp.30-212), Appendix 2 (p.229), Appendix 3 (pp.233-240), and Appendix 4 (pp.244-256). Q'anjob'al is entry #47 in the index and has full entries in all sections. The previous count of 67 was due to parser extraction errors.
